apps.name: Ammy
apps.localizedDescription:
Ammy reads what you're playing in Apple Music — title, artist, album, cover art and the live playback position — and POSTs it as JSON to an HTTPS endpoint you choose. It keeps reporting while the screen is off and while other apps are in front: an update on every track change, and a heartbeat every 30 seconds.

BUILT TO PAIR WITH ISSUN, and not limited to it. Ammy has no opinion about what receives the data — anything that accepts an HTTPS POST works.

AMMY IS A SENDER, NOT A DESTINATION. On its own it does nothing: you need something running at the other end to point it at. Setup on the phone is an address and an optional key, and nothing else. Read the repo first.

Requires iOS 26 or later, and permission to read your media library.

versions.localizedDescription:
Make the Lock Screen Spacing switch work on every flip

With Lock Screen Spacing on, the row sometimes kept the list's spacing above
and below the artwork, so everything under it moved on some flips and not
others. It now measures the list only once the row has settled, so the
Lock Screen spacing comes out the same every time.

apps.name: Albums
apps.localizedDescription:
Albums is a place to stash Apple Music albums you want to listen to later. It looks like Apple Music's own Library: a two-column grid of artwork.

SAVE FROM APPLE MUSIC. On an album or a song, tap Share, then Albums. Or paste a link.

LISTEN WHEN YOU'RE READY. Tap an album to open it in Apple Music. Mark albums as listened, and filter the grid to what you haven't heard yet.

Album details come from Apple's own catalog, looked up by the album's ID, never guessed.

IF SIDESTORE ASKS ABOUT APP EXTENSIONS, KEEP THEM. The share extension is what puts Albums in the Share menu; without it, albums can only be added by pasting a link.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
Tap an album to open it in Apple Music

Albums no longer has a page of its own for each album. Tapping a cover
now opens the album straight in Apple Music. Long-press an album to mark
it listened, share it, copy its link or delete it.
